mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate rise exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a dual market contraction that reduces consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative return prediction holds in less than 55% of instances with HOUST decline and UNRATE rise, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and rising for 3 months), higher borrowing costs reduce corporate investment and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods classified as monetary tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strengthening consumer spending power and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with rising PAYEMS, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1000.0 thousand units in a 3-month average signals a contracting housing sector that reduces construction activity and consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1000.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and rises in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicate a supply shock combined with monetary tightening, reducing corporate output and profitability and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative return prediction holds in less than 55% of instances with INDPRO decline and FEDFUNDS rise, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock regime (INDPRO declining for 3 consecutive months and falling below 95.0), reduced manufacturing output and higher input costs depress corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods classified as supply shock regimes.
